title: Data subset for road condition modelling - reference data
excerpt: Header and first 6000 complete records, original bytes and order; remaining source not used.
evaluation: Eight consecutive non-overlapping 60 m windows beginning 20 m after the first record; each run includes 20 m of preceding road and 3 m preview.
preprocessing: Convert mm to m; subtract a least-squares straight line fitted over the first 510 m; interpolate distance at 0.1 m. No amplitude rescaling or performance-based segment selection.
